# Shell row recordings

The JSON fixture contains 64 complete constructor/operation inputs, grouped by
23 public witnesses, with exact ordered frames and full cleaned output. Palettes
configure actual theme records; shipped theme modes use the existing theme files.
Runtime fields observe animation continuations and writer requests.

Replay canonically removes foreground-only color escapes on wholly space-only
actual rows; expected rows are not rewritten. This screen-identical projection
retains inverse, background and underline styling. The recording also includes
the excluded-header consistency correction and existing narrow whitespace-overflow
behavior. Every fixture record rejects unknown fields; complete inputs are unique.
